summary: 10.0.38.08 Web Studio Login Stabilization and Non-Invasive DatePicker Synchronization Engine
highlights: 1. Login Page Freeze Resolution: Eliminated unthrottled body MutationObserver recursion and DOM node wrapping that choked the JavaScript event loop on the login screen.
2. Zero-Invasive DatePicker Architecture: Reverted prototype tampering (Object.defineProperty on HTMLInputElement) and DOM wrapping; native inputs remain untouched in their exact positions.
3. Restored Native Control Visibility: Removed transparent text masking in css/app.css, ensuring datepickers and form fields render clearly and legibly across all browsers.
4. Format & Tooltip Synchronization: Cleanly synchronizes format badges ([dd/MM/yyyy]) and informative tooltips strictly matching company.dateFormat setting.
5. 100% Backend & API Compatibility: Preserves standard ISO YYYY-MM-DD input values for flawless Spring Boot backend interoperability.
